model_use: R02 G2/G3 live Jev question pilot only; no translation/publish benchmark
hold_policy: HOLD cases are manually routed and are not binary pass/fail labels.
limitations: Synthetic short sentences are not representative of historical prose; never report calibration or production accuracy from this set.
Labels derived from intentional minimal edits by assistant; not certified by bilingual domain reviewer.
JeV may not be able to identify correct sense of disputed classical characters.
